blocks.text: 🚀 Jivrus Product Suite - One Platform Many Possibilities
From Google Workspace add-ons and Zoho extensions to enterprise-grade integrations and automation, Jivrus Product Suite empowers you to:
Supercharge your data, spreadsheets, and analytics 📊
Supercharge your data, spreadsheets, and analytics 📊
Every product works seamlessly within our vision of Intelligent Integration & Hyper-Automation.
AppiWorks is an application integration platform that intelligently connects with any application and provides an ecosystem to interact with and automate those applications.

This flagship platform lets you integrate, automate, build solutions, and optimize your business processes. It's your gateway to greater efficiency and productivity in intelligent integration and hyper-automation.
AppiWorks is an iPaaS/ aPaaS platform.
Jivrus Products are available in the following marketplaces

​Jivrus Technologies offers a diverse range of products across multiple marketplaces, enhancing business processes through intelligent integration and hyper-automation. Below is an overview of the available marketplaces and the respective Jivrus Technologies products listed in each:​

Add-on products run on Google Workspace platform to enable Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Forms, Google Slides and other Google Workspace apps to operate at their full potential and automate your business process.
Start your business automation from your Google Doc or Slide

Our cloud-based document template processing products "Fillable Document" and "Fillable Slide" make your existing Google Document into a fillable form to produce templated documents. And make it is easy to generate quotes, estimates, proposals, agreement, contract, certificate, and literally any form of document that you need.
Makes Google document as live Fillable form to store responses, generate doc/ PDF, deliver via email and publish form.
Fillable Document is also available to use from Google Sheets directly to work with list of preset rows of data
Make your Google Slide a live Fillable Form to store responses, generate PDF, deliver via email and publish form.
Get your business done by powering up with Google Forms
Direct Google Form submitted data to apps within and outside Google Workspace platform.
Present Google Forms as you like for conducting Quiz, online assessments, etc..

Our cloud-based form creation product, Form Builder empowers users to effortlessly generate Google Forms and Quizzes from existing content. Whether you're working with Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, or other Google Workspace apps, our solutions streamline form creation, eliminating manual data entry.
Build your Google Form quickly from your existing Google Form, Sheet, Doc & Slide
Form Builder exclusively designed for Google Sheets. Works with Google Sheets
Form Builder exclusively designed for Google Docs. Works with Google Docs
Form Builder plus exclusively designed for all Google Workspace apps like docs, sheets, slides, forms, drive, Gmail, Calendar, Chat
Play with your Database from Google Sheet
Connect and query your Database; auto-refresh and edit it right from Google sheets.
Put your business data on the map
Build awesome maps from your Google Sheet data within a few seconds
Channelize data flow across Google Sheets
Query your favourite app or Post into the app or synchronize data between any app & Google Sheets right from Google Sheets
Extract Data from Documents into Google Sheets
ContentSense empowers users to extract data from various document types & organize them into structured spreadsheets within Google Sheets.
Launch any data as HyperList with a few clicks
HyperList transforms data from Google Sheets & Google Forms into a beautiful web-based list on your website.
Smart Evaluation. Real-Time Insights. Better Learning.
Evalix™ is a modern evaluation platform that helps schools, training institutes, and businesses conduct structured assessments, manage learners, and gain real-time performance insights.
Connect the world of applications from right inside Gmail and Calendar
Intelligent interactions with all your favourite apps from Gmail, Calendar. Contextual business view and action.
Integrate Google Sheets with QuickBooks - Connect, Query and Present
Pulls your Quick Books Data into Google Sheets and lets you play around with it
Launch Apps with Google Sheets as Database
Launch your custom Web App with one click using your spreadsheet data.
Google Cloud Marketplace is an online store where businesses can discover, deploy, and manage third-party software, services, and APIs that run on Google Cloud.
The Jivrus products that are available in Google Cloud marketplace are listed below
HubSpot AppiWorks for BigQuery is an integration of the HubSpot CRM system with BigQuery to streamline CRM data warehousing for further processing, reporting/dashboarding, or analytics.

Zoho Marketplace is an online store offering over 2,500 ready-to-use extensions and custom applications designed to enhance the functionality of Zoho products. These extensions allow users to seamlessly integrate Zoho applications with other business tools, streamlining operations and boosting productivity.
The Jivrus products that are available in Zoho marketplace are listed below
AppiWorks for Zoho CRM is a Zoho CRM extension that automates interaction between Zoho CRM modules and any other applications via AppiWorks platform.
AppiWorks Extensions for Zoho Books are Zoho Books extensions that automate interaction between Zoho Books modules and any other applications via the AppiWorks platform.
AppiWorks Extensions for Zoho Desk are Zoho Desk extensions that automate interaction between Zoho Desk modules and any other applications via the AppiWorks platform.
AppiWorks Extensions for Zoho Bigin are Zoho Bigin extensions that automate interaction between Zoho Bigin modules and any other applications via the AppiWorks platform.

Atlassian Marketplace is an online platform where users can discover, try, and purchase thousands of apps, add-ons, plugins, and integrations designed to enhance and customize Atlassian products such as Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket.
EmbedXpert enhances Jira by allowing users to seamlessly embed, view, navigate, and manage external content directly within Jira issues.
Google Looker Studio is an online data visualization tool by Google. It unlocks the power of your data with interactive dashboards and engaging reports that inspire smarter business decisions.
Jivrus Looker Studio Connectors help you to bring your data from all your favorite apps into Google Looker Studio for visualization to your heart's content.
